story.text: A very special island is inhabited only by altruists and egoists. Altruists always tell the truth, and egoists always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Sophia, and Oliver. Sophia said that Sophia is an altruist if and only if Oliver is an egoist. Oliver noted, "Sophia is an egoist if and only if Oliver is an altruist". So who is an altruist and who is an egoist? (Format your answer like: "Sophia is a altruist/egoist, and Oliver is a altruist/egoist")

options: Sophia is an egoist, Oliver is an egoist
Sophia is an altruist, Oliver is an egoist
Sophia is an altruist, Oliver is an altruist
Sophia is an egoist, Oliver is an altruist
